name: cisco-ios-lsp
description: Context-aware completions, hover docs, and diagnostics for Cisco IOS/IOS-XE config files.

cisco-ios-lsp.checkForUpdates.description: On startup, check GitHub Releases for a newer version and notify if one is available. Inactive while the repository is private.

cisco-ios-lsp.experimental.autoIndent.description: Experimental: pressing Enter after a block-opening command (interface X, vrf definition Y, ...) starts the next line indented. Takes effect immediately when toggled.

cisco-ios-lsp.outline.showSymbolsInOutli.description: Show command/interface/BGP/class-map/policy-map structure in the Outline panel and breadcrumbs.

command.description: Show prompt commands (hostname# / hostname>) in the outline.

ip_vrf.description: Show VRF declarations ('vrf definition', 'ip vrf') in the outline.

router_bgp.description: Show 'router bgp' blocks in the outline.

sub_interface.description: Show sub-interfaces (e.g. GigabitEthernet0/1.10) in the outline.

cisco-ios-lsp.outline.symbolsList.description: Per-category toggle for which symbols appear in the outline.

enumDescriptions: Faint tint behind the placeholder; the text keeps its syntax colour (default).
Quietest look, but closest to how warnings and errors appear.
Most noticeable; replaces the syntax colour of the placeholder.
Most distinct look, still clearly not an error.
No placeholder highlighting (hover note and diagnostics behaviour stay).
cisco-ios-lsp.placeholders.style.markdownDescription: How template placeholders (`<NAME>`, `$VAR`, `{{ jinja }}`, `VlanXX`, `10.10.X.1`) are highlighted. The highlight covers the whole argument. Colours: `ciscoIosLsp.placeholderBackground` / `placeholderUnderline` / `placeholderForeground` in `workbench.colorCustomizations`.

cisco-ios-lsp.placeholders.fillCharacter.markdownDescription: Characters that mark a value still to be filled in, e.g. `X` for `VlanXX`, `Gi1/0/X`, `X.X.X.X`. A letter counts as a single letter between non-letters or a run of 2+ capitals not touching other capitals (`VlanXX`, `ACL-XXX`, not `MAX`/`XXL`); a symbol counts in any run (`Vlan##`). `<NAME>`, `$VAR`, `${VAR}` and Jinja are always recognised. Avoid common letters (they hide real names) and `#` (it clashes with prompt lines like `SW1#show run`).

colors.description: Background of template placeholders (styles A and D).
Dotted underline of template placeholders (styles B and D).
Text colour of template placeholders (style C).

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
